# Supplementary Figure 7 — PfMATE

Inward- vs outward-facing states of the multidrug/toxic-compound extrusion transporter
PfMATE: **6FHZ** (inward) vs **6HFB** (outward), scored by Cα-RMSD to each reference
(x = `6fhz_rmsd`, y = `6hfb_rmsd`).

**Method (divide-and-conquer → occurrence voting).** Clade-based divide-and-conquer spreads
the MSA; occurrence voting enriches each state; the top-16 sequences per state are
re-predicted (5 models × 8 seeds = 40 structures), against a 16-random control.

**Figure** = `four_panel_rmsd_scatter.png`, generated by
`results_updated/pfmate/run3/plot_four_panel_rmsd.py`. Sources copied (read-only) from
`results_updated/pfmate/run3/`.

| Panel | Backing CSV (this folder) | Source | Rows |
|-------|---------------------------|--------|------|
| Divide & Conquer | `panel1_divide_and_conquer_structure_analysis.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/plot_rmsd_tmp/structure_analysis_results_rmsd.csv` | 9,215 |
| Inward (6FHZ) top-16 | `panel2_6fhz_inward_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_6fhz_rmsd/results/plots_rmsd/top_seq_rmsd_values.csv` | 40 |
| Outward (6HFB) top-16 | `panel3_6hfb_outward_top16.csv` | `occurrence_voting_6hfb_rmsd/results/plots_rmsd/top_seq_rmsd_values.csv` | 40 |
| Random-16 control | `panel4_random16_control.csv` | `divide_and_conquer/random_pred/prediction/structure_analysis_results.csv` | 40 |

Uses the RMSD occurrence-voting runs (`occurrence_voting_6fhz_rmsd`, `_6hfb_rmsd`), not the
separate TM-score runs.
